Luiz, it's Diane. I am sending you the sheet that we give new colleagues, and it is not the organisation chart. Ana is the one in legal who approves without going up, and she has been there nineteen years. Marco is the representative who knows every dealer in the north personally. The south is the region where most of the volume sits, which is why everybody calls you. And the last line is the one that people ignore. At the harvest dinner, ask about the soil. Two hours, guaranteed.

Luiz, Tom Baker. You asked me at dinner which region the wine came from, and I did not have a good answer, so here is the one I got. The man who poured it said it is almost never the grape. It is the place where the grape grows: the soil, the height, and the month that it rains. He said the region that everybody names is usually the one which markets itself best. Ask your growers the same question about soil. You will get the same answer.
